essays.title: Quadratic Quasi-Newton
essays.subtitle: Standalone · optimization
essays.pitch: A new optimization algorithm for smooth functions that interpolates between gradient descent and L-BFGS.

essays.title: Which Direction? → Where on the Curve?
essays.subtitle: Interactive · optimization
essays.pitch: An interactive, scroll-driven tutorial on the Quadratic Quasi-Newton (QQN) optimizer. Reframes optimization from "which direction should I move?" into "where on this curve should I stop?" — with live contour maps, deformable search curves, and a four-axis factoring that collapses a zoo of classical methods (gradient descent, momentum, L-BFGS, trust regions, OWL-QN) into points in one configuration space. Built to make the geometry something you can feel, not just read.

essays.title: RCC — Rational Certificate Complexity
essays.subtitle: Trilogy I · the foundational vocabulary
essays.pitch: The foundation of the trilogy. Treats every convergence sequence as a rational certificate engine, measures its bit-length versus demanded tolerance ε, and stratifies constants into cost classes (RC₁/RC₂/RC₃). Establishes the regularity condition, a Θ(log 1/ε) lower bound, and the central separation algebraic irrationals vs. π and e. It fixes the vocabulary the other two essays invoke.

essays.title: PI_RCC — The Simplest Increment: x + sin(x)
essays.subtitle: Trilogy II · stress-testing the boundary
essays.pitch: A cubic-convergent iteration for π whose outer recurrence is not hypergeometric — it falls outside RCC's classified class, yet still attains optimal RC₁ cost. Develops derivative engineering and the tower of continua (ℚ → algebraic → analytic → elliptic/modular → periods). Where RCC defines the cost classes, PI_RCC shows their boundary is permeable.

essays.title: NAM — Numbers as Machines
essays.subtitle: Trilogy III · the executable substrate
essays.pitch: A generator-based numerics library where every number is a forkable, deterministic nano-VM emitting an infinite digit stream. RCC's cost classes resurface here as generator state-dimension tiers, with a two-tier ABI, base-as-codec, BBP-as-resonance, and an honest interval account of equality. Where RCC measures and PI_RCC engineers, NAM builds the machine that runs them all.
